name: Nexo Tesis
distribution: standalone Windows Python application; not Nexo PC update
runtime_dependencies: Python >=3.11 stdlib/Tk/SQLite; bundled websocket-client 1.9.2 and pypdf 6.21.2; Windows PowerShell and desktop Word for native Word operations; existing Microsoft client or Edge for optional Copilot login
model_providers: Copilot365 (continuidad por defecto; recuerdo remoto no verificado)

per_turn_limits.model_requests: 2 logical generation phases; 6 transport attempts default per execution cycle

academic.flow: conversation-first; structured model proposals with host validation
academic.draft_invalidation_on_fact_changes: Content facts invalidate; guide typography does not indiscriminately invalidate drafts
academic.source_scope: Crossref metadata/abstracts, user excerpts and permission-scoped local file excerpts; returned Copilot references separately unverified
academic.guide_rule_detection: partial pattern-based proposals with evidence/scope/strength, explicit selection and approval

actions: prepare excerpt as unsent chat message
insert approved text with tracked changes
create/update native automatic table of contents
read library DOCX copy read-only with native Word
reviewed guide profile in layout and insertion

validation.model_responses: scripted fixtures; socket tests use loopback emulator

context_fixture.fixture: synthetic 11 known facts, 11 answered questions, 15 sources, 8 drafts, 8 messages; no actual user content
context_fixture.measure: Unicode characters, not tokens or cost; not a quality benchmark

validation.local_continuity_tests: 369 unit tests passed, 2 skipped; synthetic fixtures only; Tk/Xvfb not run
validation.fase6_2_tests: 476 passed / 2 skipped; 11 new synthetic regressions for the Copilot-close policy; no Windows/M365 verification
validation.fase6_3_tests: 499 passed / 2 skipped; 8 new synthetic regressions for the empirical-data boundary; reported turn stops after 1 model call instead of burning the 300-call fuse; no Windows/M365 verification
validation.fase6_4_tests: 499 passed / 2 skipped; 7 new synthetic regressions for project isolation built on an in-memory Tk double; no display, Windows, Word or network verification
validation.fase6_5_tests: 499 passed / 2 skipped; 6 new synthetic regressions for the autonomous failover budget, including an end-to-end 12-pass Agent loop on a real RoutedAPI; no Windows/M365/network verification

fixes: Project file library, reading state, version/provenance and route-scoped excerpt grants
Reviewed guide profile and selected optional sections
Short task contracts and compact selective context
Greeting-topic prevention and legacy pending-topic flag
Returned Copilot citations retained as unverified metadata

Continuidad Copilot 0.4.1-dev: hilo durable por defecto, sin rotacion a los 40 turnos, recuperacion y revocacion con decision explicita, cabecera de afinidad aislada y contexto incremental solo tras verificacion
Revocation also excludes tracked derived context from unauthorized routes
Anteproyecto does not schedule final empirical results solely because diagnostic data are present
Unknown bibliography years no longer become literal None; peer-review reports filtered
Copilot365 sin API key: el formulario de Cuentas oculta la clave, Guardar cuenta inicia Conectar escritorio M365 y Guardar y usar ofrece la conexion en lugar de pedir credenciales

Tolerancia de formato: se valida un unico objeto JSON completo aunque venga envuelto en texto o cerca json, se unifican los contratos de tarea e incremental y el aviso de error indica un motivo fijo sin volcar la respuesta del modelo

Auditoria de robustez: config concurrente con RLock e instantanea, cuarentena de config danado, ids F#/D# monotonos, proyecto legacy normalizado, expiracion Copilot tolerante, bookkeeping de rutas sin perder respuestas, version unica y preflight de carpeta de datos

Correccion del error real de formato en borradores largos (Marco teorico): limites unificados en limits.py, recorte visible en vez de rechazo, normalizacion de apartados/alias/fuentes, prompt con limite explicito, curacion de modelo Gemini 404 y reintento seguro ante 400 por response_format

fase6-2: Nexo ya no cierra Copilot/Edge tras capturar la sesion. process_guard.detach_all()/guarded_capture() conservan el proceso en exito; close_all() solo limpia huérfanos en fallo/cancelacion; el dialogo nunca cierra la sesion

fase6-3: el agente continuo ya no rellena Resultados/Discusion/Conclusiones con texto provisional cuando faltan datos. empirical.py decide si el trabajo requiere corpus, detecta placeholders semanticos y run_loop.evaluate() para con pregunta en cuanto no queda otro trabajo; gates.check_empirical() bloquea el relleno; un anteproyecto sigue pudiendo terminar sin resultados

fase6-4: al crear/abrir un proyecto NO se arrastra el estado del anterior. Application.reset_project_scope() limpia el recibo del agente, el apartado seleccionado, los limites del modo agente, los permisos de investigacion, consentimientos, texto pendiente, eventos y todos los widgets; refresh_document() borra el recibo cuando no hay last_loop; new_project() no anuncia exito si open_project() no pudo cambiar de proyecto

fase6-5: el modo autonomo con Copilot YA NO se detiene tras unos pocos pasos. routing.RoutedAPI.request() aplica attempt_limit/cycle_seconds como presupuesto DE UNA PETICION (cycle_attempts/cycle_start), no acumulado durante todo el bucle: el mismo objeto se reutiliza en cada paso y antes fallaba en el 7 con "No quedan rutas listas". El timeout por intento de Copilot paso de 90s a todo el ciclo restante para no cortar JSON largo en streaming

copilot_continuity.affinity_header: X-RoutingParameter-SessionKey on opening handshake; isolated A/B flag; third-party evidence, NOT verified by Microsoft or by this project
copilot_continuity.incremental_messages: only after explicit user verification on Copilot-only routes; full context otherwise
copilot_continuity.uncertain_result: keeps identifiers and requires an explicit user decision; never silently re-sends or rebinds
copilot_continuity.revocation: requires an explicit clean-thread decision; sent material remains in Microsoft
copilot_continuity.local_tests: 369 passed / 2 skipped; no authenticated Microsoft session

release_status: development build at releases/nexo-tesis-v0.4.1-dev-windows.zip (fase6-5: the autonomous Copilot loop no longer exhausts the route failover budget after ~6 passes and long streamed answers get the full cycle timeout; fase6-4 isolates new projects; fase6-3 requires a confirmed corpus; fase6-2 keeps Copilot open after capture; Fases 0-6 core); NOT a published release; remote Copilot continuity unverified

ready_to_use.external_requirement: Python >=3.11 with Tkinter and SQLite; package installs nothing
ready_to_use.bundled_dependencies: websocket-client and pypdf vendored in the package

development_package.self_check_branches_tested: failure (Tk missing on Linux) and success (Tk simulated)
development_package.self_check_marker: fase6-5 + 8 lineas OK (borradores, busqueda, herramientas, fases 1-6, sesion Copilot, datos empiricos, aislamiento de proyectos, modo autonomo)

robustness.config_corrupt_quarantine: config-invalido-<timestamp>.json, one copy, UI can reconfigure

limits.oversized_draft: trimmed at a paragraph boundary with a visible in-draft notice, never rejected

continuous_agent.in_place_research: research.research_for with per-query approval, 4 APIs, provenance

empirical_boundary.requires_results: false for anteproyecto/protocolo; true for empirical studies
empirical_boundary.placeholder_detection: semantic markers, accent-folded; literal markers still in gates
empirical_boundary.stop_reason: pregunta (human boundary, NOT a step quota)
empirical_boundary.hard_gate: gates.check_empirical blocks filler and unconfirmed empirical drafts

project_isolation.ui_reset: Application.reset_project_scope() called by open_project() and render()
project_isolation.receipt_label: doc_status cleared when last_loop is absent

autonomous_loop.failover_budget_scope: per request, not per agent turn
autonomous_loop.copilot_timeout: full remaining cycle instead of a fixed 90s cap
